verdict.rationale: Dropbox has public plan pages (dropbox.com/plans, business/plans-comparison), but the cited snippets only show adjacent per-plan features: file-transfer size limits (50/100 GB) and deleted-file restore windows (30/180 days/1 year). Nothing in the pack shows per-plan storage quotas, per-user prices, or what happens when an account hits its storage cap. A pricing axis clearly applies to a cloud storage product, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.
